title: Understanding SVD
text: The matrix S in Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) contains the singular values of the original matrix X. These values are related to the variance in the data along the principal components.

title: Variance and Singular Values
text: The variance in the direction of a principal component is given by the square of the corresponding singular value divided by the number of observations.

title: Calculate Variance for PC2
text: The singular value for PC2 is $$2$$. Calculate the variance by squaring this value and dividing by the number of observations (6).
